summary: Verified DJ END LIVE confirm mini-dialog end-to-end. All requested behaviors work as specified.

test_results.host_end_live_button: PASS — pub-leave-btn visible with text 'End Live' after DJ goes live from camera (LiveKit connected as dj_57cae364...).
test_results.confirm_dialog_appears: PASS — clicking pub-leave-btn shows pub-confirm-end with title 'End the live broadcast?', subtitle 'Your viewers will drop off immediately.', and buttons pub-keep-live-btn ('Keep Broadcasting') and pub-confirm-end-btn ('End Live'). pub-leave-btn is removed from DOM while confirm is shown.
test_results.keep_broadcasting_dismisses: PASS — clicking pub-keep-live-btn hides pub-confirm-end and brings pub-leave-btn back. Zero POST /api/livekit/stream/stop calls made (verified via page.on('request') network capture).
test_results.confirm_end_live_stops_stream: PASS — clicking pub-confirm-end-btn fires POST /api/livekit/stream/stop (1 call, 200). LiveKit disconnects, UI returns to pre-broadcast state (dj-go-live-camera-btn visible). GET /api/livekit/streams/active returns [].
test_results.regression_icon_controls: PASS — after dismissing confirm via Keep Broadcasting, pub-toggle-mic-btn / pub-toggle-cam-btn / pub-flip-cam-btn all visible and mic toggle click succeeds.
test_results.guest_no_confirm: PASS (code review) — StageGrid renders <PublisherControls onLeave={onLeaveStage} label="Leave Stage" /> without isHost; onClick handler at line 450 is `isHost ? setConfirmEnd(true) : onLeave?.()` so guest tap calls onLeave immediately with no confirm dialog. Button label uses `{isHost ? 'End Live' : label}` = 'Leave Stage'. Not exercised in live browser due to single-session sandbox.

critical_code_review_comments: LiveKitStream.jsx still uses window.location.origin instead of process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — carried over from prior iteration; still recommend switching for consistency.

Confirm dialog copy is good, but consider adding aria-labelledby pointing to the title

for slightly better a11y (currently role='alertdialog' + aria-live='assertive' only).
test_credentials: DJ Mike Johnson id 57cae364-b31f-4920-909f-fda18fc78fe6, location edgewood-atlanta (loaded via localStorage ff_dj_profile with current_location override).
context_for_next_testing_agent: PublisherControls now has an inline confirm mini-dialog for hosts. Selectors: pub-leave-btn (End Live for host / Leave Stage for guest), pub-confirm-end (the red-tinted dialog container), pub-keep-live-btn (cancel), pub-confirm-end-btn (confirm stop). Host click on pub-leave-btn shows confirm; only pub-confirm-end-btn triggers POST /api/livekit/stream/stop. Guests skip the confirm entirely.
